narrative.details:
The order has come down, champion. Varimathras himself has requested that I send my most 'capable' agents back to the Undercity for a highly sensitive tactical operation.

Unfortunately, my most capable agents were killed over three years ago. In their stead I have a collection of brain dead riff-raff.

<Nathanos stares coldly at you.>

Travel to the Undercity at once and report to Varimathras. Do not embarrass me, champion!
narrative.objectives: Travel to the Undercity and speak with Varimathras.
narrative.offerRewardText: The Grand Crusader sits safely in the Scarlet Bastion while his forces pour into your lands, desecrate your structures and monuments and murder your people.The Dark Lady has commanded that I deal with this insect once and for all. You will become the instrument of the Forsaken's reckoning.
